review_notes: I reviewed all of NormForms/HomogeneousSystemZeros.lean (lines 1–155) and compared it with the sources it relies on: PaddedSubstitution.lean, CoordinateNormIteration.lean and MultivariatePolynomials/IteratedBlockSubstitution.lean. The file has two proofs, homogeneous_block_step and the main theorem, and they do not repeat each other's reasoning. The zero-padding evaluation and homogeneity arguments are already factored into eval_aeval_pad_eq_zero_imp and IsHomogeneous.aeval_pad, which the target calls. The reindex-and-surjectivity ending is a short idiom, and the two equivOfCardEq calls are routine. The iterated block substitution lemmas handle a single polynomial, whereas the target substitutes distinct forms into a padded outer polynomial, so a shared lemma would not simplify either use. I did not search the other Formal Frontier libraries exhaustively.
